working_definition: Glial cells of the adult antenna (Li et al. 2022 FCA, Manual Annotation; broad class glial cell), a single antenna glial type without subtype resolution.
justification: FBbt has no term for glia of the antenna as a whole. 'glial cell of adult antennal nerve' denotes nerve glia only, and the antennal lobe glia terms are CNS glia. Generic glial or PNS glial terms would be a fallback rather than the type the authors name, so the cluster is held.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Glial cell of the adult antennal nerve (child of PNS glial cell).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Restricted to the antennal nerve; not the antenna glia named by the authors.

recommendation: No adequate FBbt term; hold the cluster (best_match null). Possible new term: adult antennal glial cell.
